arguments.command:
cd /tmp/h3 && cat > cpu.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, resource, subprocess, sys, time, os
doc = {"seed":"s","definitions":[
    ["line","b'X: ' + b'a' * 540 + b'\\r\\n'"],
    ["req","b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h\\r\\n' + line * 120 + b'\\r\\n'"]],
    "timeout_ms":5,"cases":[],"events":[],
    "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"{{ req * 20000 }}"}]}]}
raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
code = ("import resource,sys,json,os\n"
        "sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')\n"
        "import main\n"
        "doc=json.loads(sys.stdin.buffer.read().decode())\n"
        "out=main.run(doc)\n"
        "u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)\n"
        "sys.stderr.write('CPU %.2fs user %.1fs sys, %.1f MB maxrss\\n'%(u.ru_utime+u.ru_stime,u.ru_utime,u.ru_maxrss/1024))\n"
        "sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(out)[:60])\n")
t=time.time()
p = subprocess.run(['python3','-B','-c',code], input=raw, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace/project')
print('wall %.1fs' % (time.time()-t), p.stderr.decode()[:100])
PYEOF
timeout 200 python3 cpu.py
